nom: FARMACY Mini Green Clean Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I used to use an liquid oil based cleanser to remove my make up. I wanted to try this one out because they had an offer with points going on. I have really sensitive skin that flares up whenever I use new products, however, that did not happen with this cleanser/make up remover. It really does melt all the make up off, even my stubborn mascara. I love that. It doesn't have any strong fragrance to it and it really leaves my face feeling clean while not irritating it.

avis.titre: Leaves a residue that's difficult to remove!
avis.texte: I've gotten this product before but i think it was reformulated, because last time it worked perfectly but this time is a lot different. This is my second night using it now and i might return it because i use it as directed, but no matter how many times i rinse my face the makeup/ balm residue does not come off! It only comes off if i take it off with a damp rag and I'd rather not do that. It used to come off with warm water no problem. It does get the makeup off but it stays since the balm will not wash off.
I love this cleansing balm. We're going on vacation for a week and bought this mini for the trip.

avis.titre: Smells good but doesn't take off makeup
avis.texte: I got recommended this by an employee because the makeup melt I wanted was out of stock. It smelt good and feels good on skin but I'm left with most of my makeup still on.

The only benefit of this product is the clean ingredients and that it may be more cost effective than liquid or wipes. This product burns my eyes even though I apply when my eyes are closed. I bought the fragrance free option. I also have to apply a second coat because the first application does not fully take off my mascara. I will not buy again.
This works so well at taking off all my make-up, I don't need to follow-up with anything else. Leaves my face squeaky clean without drying it out.
Love this product! My skin feels clean without drying. And i love the scent, and that it has clean ingredients and is cruelty free!

I have used soooo many Cleansing balms. However, Green Clean is the best ever. The smell is fresh and my skin feels extremely clean with zero residue. The best part is... it doesn't burn my eyes! Green Clean is the GOAT!

I tried this after receiving a sample and loved how well it does at removing makeup and cleansing my skin. I bought this to use when traveling as there is no concern about it leaking or getting through airport security. It does a great job and will definitely purchase again.

This cleansing balm is wonderful and this order was for my second container as I've literally scraped the bottom of the barrel on my first. This balm literally melts the makeup off my face and even takes off my eye makeup without burning my eyes. I'm glad I was convinced to try this a few months back. I was a bit skeptical because I have very sensitive eyes but the salesperson was right - no burning at all. I love the way it makes my skin feel afterwards....not greasy but sort of dewy.

avis.titre: Removes all makeup easily and leaves skin hydrated.
avis.texte: I loved this product! I've tried several other cleansers before, but even after massaging them into my skin, there was always some makeup residue left. They just weren't strong enough to remove sunscreen and foundation. This product, on its own (without using the second liquid cleanser for double cleansing), was able to remove all my makeup. It melts perfectly into your skin, creating a thin layer that effortlessly dissolves any makeup. After using it, my face feels hydrated and refreshed.
A little goes a long way in this make up remover. Comes with its own scoop inside the lid. I have the unscented and love it.

I've been using this as a makeup removing balm prior to washing my face and I love it. It smells great, works like a charm, and its the perfect first product to kick off cleansing. I have somewhat sensitive skin & this has not upset my face at all.

avis.titre: I hate splashing my face with water
avis.texte: I bought this because I hate splashing my face with water. With this, I just spread a sparing amount over my face, massage it around, then wipe it away with a hot damp cloth and immediately moisturize. This will be so helpful for someone like me who is sensory sensitive but wants to get their skincare accomplished

The original melting balm in the white container was my holy grail. I wear lots of waterproof items and it's important that my makeup breaks down before I go in with a facewash. I was skeptical about the new formula but still gave it a shot. First off, the balm does not met like it used to. I end up still having clumps. Second, you have to use a LOT more product to even get some of your makeup to budge. Third, it just didnt seem to melt my waterproof mascara off like it used to. This is so disheartening as nothing else on the market compared. I will no longer purchase this balm as the price is not worth the mediocre product. For those of you who loved the OG, I suggest trying out Naturiums cleaning balm (purple container). Its pretty close, but you still need to really rub that mascara!

I always used the original formula (white container) and absolutely loved the product. I ran out and only the reformulated (green container) was available. I didnt think much and bought it and used that evening. For starters it doesnt melt like the original, it still had small pieces that just stayed in mini clumps. It did not remove my eye makeup and just smeared it around. I dont even wear waterproof stuff! I did notice a slight tingling/burning feeling and omg my eyes!! They were irritated for a few hours, mainly my lids and around them. My face did feel smooth but definitely not worth the price or irritation. Im returning this tonight and will have to find another go to face wash. Unless you find the original formula I'd stay away.

I love this product! I read a wirecutter review saying it was good for all skin types and with dry skin I was skeptical, but it is true. It comes with a scoop for getting out the product and removes makeup without pulling harshly on your skin leaving it feeling soft and smooth. Go buy it right away!

it gets the job done, but I find myself needing to follow up with another cleanser every time. and it DOES NOT remove my waterproof eyeliner and mascara 😭 for the price I bought it at it feels a little like a rip off, so I will not be purchasing again unfortunately.

Found myself breaking out because I wasn't properly removing my sunscreen. Found this during a spontaneous visit and decided to give it a try. Instantly noticed my skin feeling cleaner and my pores have been minimized and my oily skin kept in place. Really great product and certainly recommend for super sensitive skin.
Hurt so dang bad 😭 I'm writing this the next morning, and my eyes are still burning. It worked so well ehcih makes this even more sad.

For those looking for a Clean ingredient, Cruelty free, fragrance free Cleansing balm this is a good option. It removes makeup, SPF layers, and excess impurities from the skin. I loved using it as a slip layer for dermaplaning, and it did NOT itritate my skin or eyes. However With the price point of nearly $40 (almost $12 per oz), not effectively removing mascara, and leaving a film on the skin when it shouldn't, I wouldn't repurchase.
Wasn't a big fan of any cleansing balm but this one is perfect for me! Feels great on the skin- a little goes along way. Light and the fragrance is super nice.
I loved this instantly! I had been using oil but it wasn't removing my makeup. I tried Farmacy cleaning balm and noticed a HUGE DIFFERENCE!!! I have very sensitive skin and this didnt bother me!

avis.titre: Takes of makeup and leaves face feeling clean, but not dry
avis.texte: I love this balm! I have been using Vaseline to take my make up off since I was in high school, which worked by always left a greasy residue - not this stuff! Takes make up off gently, but efficiently and leaves skin feel soft and oh so clean!
I loved the original formula, used the new one twice and my skin was so red and irritated. So disappointing.
Cleans skin without over drying! I use even on makeup-free days!

I hate that they reformulated it. It was the perfect no residue, balm to oil remover. Now instead of turning into an oil it turns a bit more greasy, kind of reminiscent of petroleum jelly. It's still a good product, but not perfect.

I've used a few viral makeup remover products (marketing works on me 😅) and this one has been my favorite. It feels good on the skin and always takes the make up off without issue. Just to be transparent: I don't use setting spray. So I don't know how this would work against that.
This product was my go-to for years. The new formula smells, its waxy, it barely melts makeup, and its difficult to remove. The old formula was a dream. I will never purchase this product again.

avis.titre: this used to be a holy grail now it is not
avis.texte: Don't get me wrong. this is still a good product but compared to the original formula it feels like I waisted my money. I'll still use it because I bought it, but I have a few complaints. One I don't think they had a fragrance-free version originally but now it burns my eyes when it for sure didn't before. (I assume the fragrance free one won't have this problem but I didn't have this issue with the original product) It also takes a while for the product to fully emulsify, and I was rubbing a lot to get all of my makeup off. also, they had a price increase on the new formulation which always annoys me especially if the product is "worse". It works but there are better products for cheaper. it's not terrible but i wont purchase again.

I loved the original product and had been using it for several years. It went on smoothly and washed off easily. Now all this new version does is smear my makeup all over my face and when I try to wash it off it feels like petroleum jelly. It's gross. I have always double washed even with the original product but this new version makes me have to triple wash. I will be returning it and looking for something else. Farmacy ruined a good thing.

avis.titre: I will be buying this again!!
avis.texte: I am so glad I asked the associate for a recommendation on a cleansing balm and she pointed out this one. It makes my face feel so clean and yet moisturized once rinsed off. It will definitely be part of my daily routine.

avis.titre: The best for makeup removal and double cleansing!!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleansing balm. I have been using this since 2020. It dles a great job removing my mascara and any makeup i have on. It also is great to use as my double cleanser. I have never had any breakouts from using this. Its really good at cleansing my skin. I use it 2 times for rne week. Follow with a gel cleanser.
New formula is not as good as the old. I wish it would go back.

avis.titre: Was a big fan. Then the formula changed
avis.texte: I've been using this for so so long and it was my favorite and go to. Then the formula changed and now my eyes are super sensitive to it and I can't even use it to take eye makeup off because of how sensitive my eyes now are to it. Before I could rub it all over and get every last bit melted off. Upset the formula changed. It was such an amazing first step

Doesn't exacerbate my rosacea! Love this balm for double cleansing, but it's also not too greasy to use as a singular cleanser (does not leave a thick residue after rinsing or wiping off). Leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. Will purchase again!

The old formula was better. It removed makeup quicker and my skin washed clean with water alone. There is a scent to this despite it being fragrance free and it's not a pleasant scent. It does the job but I would prefer the old formula.
Really disappointed at the new formulation. After using daily this for 5 years, I am stepping away from Green Clean.
Have to have this cleansing balm! I don't feel like my make fully comes off unless I use this balm!
Been using for a week or two as part of my beauty regime when getting home from work. I love how easy it takes my makeup off and my skin looks so hydrated! Definitely a keeper and reasonably priced.
This is my holy grail makeup remover. It takes all of my makeup off. I absolutely love this product. 10/10

This product was kindly gifted by farmacybeauty. This is a really good making removing balm that is gently yet effective on the skin. That being said it's pretty standard and doesn't do anything special. It works well but there are cheaper options

I love this cleansing balm. It has a soft, buttery texture that melts into the skin and removes all my makeup even waterproof without leaving any greasy residue. It smells fresh and natural, and it leaves my skin feeling clean, hydrated, and glowing. It's perfect for my double cleansing routine and never irritates my skin. I would definitely repurchase it! Complimentary from farmacybeauty

This is one of my favorite cleansing balms I've tried. I love the sensory experience of using it, it has a lemony herbal scent. The formula is really good at removing makeup, and isn't difficult to rinse off at all. Gifted by Farmacy.

I recently tried the cleansing balm from Farmacy, and overall, it's pretty good. It melts makeup easily and leaves my skin feeling soft. The texture is smooth, though it can feel a bit greasy if you use too much. The scent is light and pleasant. I appreciate that it rinses off well with warm water. While it's not my absolute favorite balm, it definitely does a solid job at removing impurities and giving my skin a fresh, clean feel. Gifted by Pharmacy

This is such a great cleansing balm formula! It effortlessly removes all makeup, including waterproof formulas, without drying out my skin. Plus, it's gentle enough that I haven't experienced any irritation. Complimentary from farmacybeauty
Best stuff ever!! It just melts away your make up. I use it before my cleanser…it gets all make up off plus mascara. I highly recommend.

This is a must have! I've been using it every day to cleanse away the makeup, dirt, oil and sweat effortlessly! The balm warms up quickly in hands and does an amazing job to deep clean the skin of all impurities, without stripping the skin! I follow up with a gentle foaming cleanser for the best clean skin feel. Definitely recommend! Gifted by Farmacy

An all-time, holy grail, hall of FAME cleansing balm for me. This takes off everything, feels so silky on the skin, rinses clean & makes my skin look and feel divine. Truly the best value for money! Received complimentary from Farmacy Beauty

The Farmacy cleansing balm is so soft and takes off all of my makeup. No more makeup wipes, this is the best way to take off makeup! Double cleansing with a balm and then following up with. Cleanser is going to lead to good skin Complimentary from farmacybeauty

It's just a wonderful makeup melter and skin softener. The new packaging is beautiful, and my skin feels super hydrated after using! I'm pretty lazy and like to wash my face with 1 product only to remove my makeup and clean the skin, and this is definitely it! Gifted by Farmacy beauty
New formula is horrible! So sad that it changed :( now I can't use this anymore

This Clean Cleansing Balm makes taking off makeup effortless. Even the most stubborn mascara lifts away without a struggle. It feels silky going on and leaves my skin fresh, smooth, and comfortable. No residue, just clean and happy skin. A new staple in my routine. Gifted by Pharmacy Beauty.

Ive been a Farmacy lover for years! This cleansing balm was one of the first expensive skincare products I bought for myself and she is wonderful! Takes my makeup off really well even my waterproof mascara! It's slightly scented but not so much so that it bothers me. complimentary from farmacybeauty

I love how effortlessly the FARMACY Green Clean balm melts off my makeup even waterproof mascara! It feels silky, smells fresh, and leaves my skin soft and hydrated without any greasy residue. A little goes a long way, and I really appreciate the cleaner formula and eco-friendly packaging. Gifted by farmacybeauty

Gifted by farmacybeauty. I tried the Green Clean Cleansing Balm by Farmacy and can't stop using. This is the best cleansing balm I've ever tried and I highly recommend this product. Leaves my skin feeling so clean after make up remover and not harsh or dry. Highly recommend ditching make up wipes.

I received this complimentary from farmacybeauty and I love it! This green cleansing balm melts away makeup and sunscreen effortlessly. The texture is buttery smooth, transforms into an oil on skin, and rinses clean without residue. Leaves my face soft, fresh, and never stripped—perfect for a double cleanse.

This is one of my favorite cleansing balms. It feels so luxurious to use it and it really does get rid of all my makeup and sunscreen on my face. It's very hydrating and doesn't leave my skin tight like some cleansers do. I'm a convert to cleansing balms! This was gifted by Farmacy Beauty.

avis.titre: Farmacy makes THE best cleansing balms
avis.texte: Farmacy hands-down makes the best cleansing balms. I love the original and this new version that contains plant-based waxes works just as well, and breaks down every bit of makeup, skincare and debris. I also love that it is housed in post-consumer recycled packaging. 10/10! Complimentary from Farmacy

Gifted by Farmacy Beauty, green clean cleansing bomb has been one of my favorites for years, even with the new outside the inside is still as powerful as ever, and not only clean your face takes off your lash glue removed waterproof mascara, but it also your face feeling fresh renewed and totally moisturized while most cleansers strip your skin this nourishes your skin I highly recommend it

It was a big fan of the original formula, but this new formulation is smooth, creamy and still as effective. I like to scoop a little bit with my fingernail and rubber and dry into my skin. This is a really great job at breaking down my eyeliner, which always tends to be my issue. Gifted by farmacy

If makeup wipes don't quite cut it for you, you definitely need to try this cleansing balm! It melts makeup effortlessly and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I personally would choose the fragrance free option next time. Complimentary from Farmacy.

I'm a big fans of their toner , and is so exited to try this cleansing balm . This balm melts all the makeups and easy to rinse off with warm water , and my skin feels soft and hydrated after use . With the SPF , it's go to protect from being sunburned. Gifted by farmacybeauty.

complimentary from farmacybeauty. I've been using the FARMACY Green Clean cleansing balm for a while now, and I honestly love it. The smell is really nice—kind of fresh and a little citrusy, but not too strong. It feels good when I put it on my face. It removes all my makeup and sunscreen super easily. Even waterproof mascara comes off without scrubbing. Way better than makeup wipes, which always made my skin feel dry and never fully clean. After using this balm, my skin feels really soft and smooth. It doesn't feel dry or tight at all, actually, it feels more hydrated than before. One cleanse is all I need, and my skin looks and feels great. Definitely one of my favorite skincare products!

I used the past formula and had no complaints, however, after using this one i am speechless. The way it melts the makeup so easily is amazing! I would definitely purchase this product. It is gentle to my skin and leaves my face feeling clean Gifted by farmacybeauty

I always hear great things about this brand which is why I was super excited to try this as the first step for washing my face. It does a great job at getting all the oil and junk out of my face. This product was gifted by farmacy.

avis.titre: great product that delivers exactly what it promises
avis.texte: I really liked the FARMACY Green Clean cleansing balm. It easily removes makeup, even waterproof, and does not leave a greasy film. The texture is gentle, and upon contact with water it turns into milk. After use, the skin is soft, moisturized, and not tight. The aroma is light and natural. The packaging is convenient and well thought out. A high-quality product that fully meets expectations. Complimentary from farmacybeauty

Melts everything down, my mascara, SPF, even the stubborn stuff without needing a second go. The texture is buttery but not greasy, and I actually enjoy the scent, fresh without being overpowering. FARMACY got the formula right on this one. gifted by farmacybeauty

Melts everything down, my mascara, SPF, even the stubborn stuff without needing a second go. The texture is buttery but not greasy, and I actually enjoy the scent, fresh without being overpowering. FARMACY got the formula right on this one. gifted by farmacybeauty

Farmacy Green Clean Cleansing Balm is a game changer! It melts away makeup effortlessly—even waterproof—without stripping my skin. Leaves my face soft, clean, and refreshed with a light citrusy scent. A little goes a long way. Definitely a staple in my skincare routine! Gifted by Farmacybeauty

This cleansing balm does amazing work in terms of removing all of my makeup I feel that it takes away any dirt and leaves my face feeling refresh. I always been a big of farmacy so this is perfect!!! This was gifted by farmacybeauty

Farmacy's Green Clean Cleansing Balm effectively removes makeup and leaves skin feeling soft. The natural ingredients and pleasant scent make it a great addition to any skincare routine. I definitely recommend. gifted by thefamacy.

I'm a long time lover of Green Clean. It's the only thing I've found that truly melts away all of my spf and makeup without tugging on my skin that also rinses easily and cleanly. It completely replaced makeup wipes for me since there's no need to irritate my skin by wiping and pulling. I can't recommend it enough! This item was gifted by FarmacyBeauty in exchange for my honest review.

I love this cleansing balm! It literally melts your makeup off and your face isn't left feeling dry! It feels so smooth after rinsing! I love how it also removes waterproof mascara! It's also long lasting! Gifted by farmacybeauty

I finally tried the Farmacy Green Clean cleansing balm and totally get the hype now. It melts off makeup so fast (even waterproof mascara) and leaves my skin feeling soft, not greasy. The texture is super buttery and it smells really fresh without being overpowering. I've been using it as my first cleanse at night and it makes everything else work better. Definitely a new staple in my routine. Gifted by farmacybeauty!

Gifted by farmacy. I've used many different oils and melting balms as a first step in my night time skin care routine and I always come back to this one. It melts well, dissolves all of my base products and even waterproof eye makeup. It does not break me out. And leaves my skin soft.

The original formula I thought was the gold standard for cleansing balms. I can't really tell a difference in this formation but it still removes my makeup great without dragging my skin! Melts like butter. Gifted by farmacy

This balm is a game-changer! The light citrusy scent is refreshing without being overpowering. It melts off makeup, SPF, even waterproof mascara effortlessly — way more effective and gentler than wipes. After just one use, my skin felt soft, smooth, and super hydrated. Plus, love the eco-friendly packaging and plant-based formula. Total win! So happy I got this gifted by Farmacy.

This cleansing balm was my holy grail and I usually purchased from the competitor store but since it became available at Ulta I ordered however it is not the same. It's more waxy, less smooth and more difficult at removing my mascara than the older formula. Not the same quality.
Been waiting on this to arrive at Ulta! I've tried soooo many (10+) cleansing balms, and nothing beats this one. I've cleaned the jar and repurchased at least 5 times. Pricey, but worth every penny!

This Makeup Cleansing balm has been really nice to my skin. It removes dirt, makeup and SPF effortlessly. This makeup cleansing balm has been able to melt and removes my waterproof mascara easily. I love this because i don't have to be rough on my skin to remove my mascara. The formula leaves my skin nourished, smooth and clean with just a bit pf the product. The scent is citrusy, natural and subtle. Gifted by farmacybeauty

This is officially my favorite cleansing balm! Complimentary from farmacybeauty, I have used up 3 bottles already. It melted in my palm like a sorbet icecream, not oily not greasy, super fresh and melt all my makeup's including eyeshadows!

This is perfect for double cleansing. Melts makeup and sunscreen off (which I've been using a ton of since it's summer). Gentle and doesn't leave a residue! I was using Banila Co previously and like this much better. Gifted by Farmacy for my authentic opinion.

This cleansing balm is great. My makeup comes off easily and has a fresh feeling after. It melts down nicely and breaks down my makeup for the day. Great for travel as well and on the go. Gifted by farmacybeauty.

Forever obsessed with this cleansing balm, gifted by Farmacy. I like to melt it completely before applying it to my face as my first cleansing step for the easiest removal of makeup and SPF. It's gentle around my eyes and rinses clean so easily. A little goes a long way and my skin loves it. I will repurchase this over and over again.

This was my first introduction ever to a cleansing balm, and nothing that I've tried since has ever compared. The solid to oil consistency is so fun to use! I always double cleanse so I didn't notice any major difference in the reformulation. The scent is subtle, but it is pleasant and spa like. This was offered by farmacybeauty

This is the best facial cleanser on the market. I did receive this Complimentary from farmacybeauty, but I have purchased this 3 times from farmacy and it's game changing. I love that it doesn't strip my skin.

This is my favorite cleansing balm, and the new packaging is so cute! I love the scent- it's light and pleasant. I also love how easily it removes my makeup. Even waterproof makeup just melts away and washes right off. Gifted by Farmacy

Three years I've been using make up wipes, but as i've gotten older, I realize they can be pretty rough on the skin so I've been looking for products. I can really be more gentle and provide more nourishment to my skin. Well cleansing it. I was so excited to try this because it works so well, it makes my skin feel so nourished and takes out all the impurities and dirt from throughout the day. Gifted by farmacybeauty

I absolutely love this cleansing balm and have been through many tubs. It has a perfect soft texture while still being rich enough to remove even my mascara. I also love that this version is fragrance free. gifted by farmacy

This cleansing balm was gifted by Farmacy in exchange for my review. I've used this product before and have enjoyed it. It does a good job at removing my makeup including mascara. It doesn't leave a residue and my face feels clean.

First, I bought this with my own money. I see a lot of confusing reviews and media tied to these products so I wanted to elaborate that there are four, new Farmacy products. There are two cleansing balms and then there are two face wash cleansers. Each pair has a with fragrance or fragrance free option so that you can choose what is suitable for your skin. With that being said, it is a reformulation of their previous cleansing balm and face wash. And people are angry and upset and leave bad reviews on these products simply because they are mad at Farmacy for reformulating. Bad behavior. I say that because when looking at these products from Farmacy, you might have to do what i did and just got for it because all the reviews said it sucked and they wanted the old formula back. I, however, hated the old formula from the moment it released and always thought they needed to change it, so i came circling back to this cleansing balm when they rebranded it. So if you survived my preface: my honest thoughts are this cleansing balm (i bought the fragrance free version) is so, so, so amazing. It is perfect. I have had zero irritation, or breakouts, it feels good, washes off good, is a perfect first step cleanse and truthfully will be "the one" for as long as they keep this formula around. I love the way they did things as far as having a "normal" version and "sensitive skin" version to choose from…and from years of avoiding this brand, I now stand by them. I look forward to using this
